- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on proper form and technique for common exercises: squats, deadlifts, and bench press.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for squats include:
  1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
  2. Keep your back straight.
  3. Lower down slowly.

  6. Avoid letting your back arch.
